primary_web_sources.use: Primary original model citation identified; full IEEE paper text was not accessible in this audit. The precise implemented equations and validity guards are pinned in calculator.py.

primary_web_sources.use: Original model bibliographic citation; publisher full text unavailable. The implemented quasi-static version, finite-thickness correction and validity guard remain pinned implementation evidence.

local_primary_policy_scope.operator_decisions: Frozen actual OPERATOR-DECISIONS-2026-10-03.md; standing fast50/controlled-pair policy, not a release of ROOT104 historical dimensions
local_primary_policy_scope.historical_controlled_nets: Frozen ROOT104 controlled-nets.json204 targets100IMP50/96DIFF100/6DIFF90/2DIFF120; all204 map uniquely to exact current native-matched pad net names. Historical lengths/reference samples/timing conclusions remain historical.
local_primary_policy_scope.AO1_DAC_SCLK: Current matched native pads U14623.15 ISO7761FDWR and U14626.6 AD5683RBRMZ-3 share exact /motherboard_analog_output/AO1_DAC_SCLK. Historical fastest-edge evidence comes from ISO7761 switching data and SCLK function; this audit did not recompute current route length, bus timing or load/return behavior.
local_primary_policy_scope.edge_electrical_length: Historical classifier reuses ISOW1432 stub-length guidance as a conservative line-screening inference. This is not a generic datasheet mandate that every selected signal must use50 ohm. Current policy requalification remains OPEN.

calculator_validation_scope.A: IPC approximations; validity guard is from the frozen implementation. In3 legal widths fail the stated guard, so A cannot be counted as an independent valid inner method.
calculator_validation_scope.B: H&J/K&J outer closed forms; Cohn/Wheeler mixed-offset parallel-capacitance approximation inner model.
calculator_validation_scope.C: Independent finite-volume quasi-static Laplace model using rectangular conductors; bounded one-thread inner nominal/corner solves at two meshes. No fabrication solver, dispersion/loss, copper roughness, unknown mask dielectric, current plane/return topology or adjacent copper qualification.
calculator_validation_scope.tests: 20 frozen calculator controls pass, including self-reported published worked examples and hand evaluations. This checks the saved implementation against those controls, not independent publisher-paper transcription.
